maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from auction marketplace sales and commissions on surplus assets (GovDeals, AssetZone), not repairing or servicing installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Sellers are mostly commercial enterprises and retailers plus some government agencies via GovDeals; buyers are private bidders, so government isn't the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by expanding its marketplaces and seller programs; acquisitions, such as the recent collectibles and art one, are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Sellers can switch to other auction or liquidation firms; surplus disposal is episodic, though AssetZone software adds some stickiness.

notes: Revenue split between commercial and government sellers is not stated in the text.
